title: Patrick Corporation - proposed acquisition of additional shares in Virgin Blue Airlines

body_sections.Summary: Patrick Corporation - proposed acquisition of shares in Virgin Blue.
body_sections.Market definition: The Commission did not consider market definition to be a critical issue in this matter, but considered that the most relevant markets were likely to be: * domestic air passenger transport services; * domestic air freight services; and * the market for the provision of international air passenger transport services on particular routes.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission decided that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any market.  The Commission took into consideration possible vertical integration issues arising from Patrick's airport-related operations.  However, the Commission noted that Patrick already owns 46% of Virgin Blue shares and that Patrick's airport-related operations already have close links with Virgin Blue.
